items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Well, Nat Jones and Sax Mallard. Until Duke started robbing Fambro of his men.

ctx.x: Yeah. There wasn't nothing but beans and rice, but it filled us up, you know. And who else? Well, Nat Jones and Sax Mallard. Until Duke started robbing Fambro of his men.
He did that to a few bands didn't he?
